def find_closest_bwoman(image):
    # Create an ImagePatch object for the image
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)

    # Find all patches of "bwoman" in the image
    bwoman_patches = image_patch.find("bwoman")

    # If no "bwoman" patches are found, return None
    if not bwoman_patches:
        return None

    # Calculate the distance of each "bwoman" patch from the center of the image
    center_x = image_patch.right - image_patch.left
    center_y = image_patch.upper - image_patch.lower
    for bwoman in bwoman_patches:
        bwoman.distance_from_center = math.sqrt((bwoman.left - center_x)**2 + (bwoman.lower - center_y)**2)

    # Sort the "bwoman" patches by their distance from the center of the image
    bwoman_patches.sort(key=lambda bwoman: bwoman.distance_from_center)

    # Return the "bwoman" patch closest to the center of the image
    return bwoman_patches[0]

def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    boy_patches = image_patch.find("boy")
    shirt_patches = image_patch.find("shirt")
    
    if not boy_patches or not shirt_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    boy_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in boy_patches]
    shirt_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in shirt_patches]
    
    boy_shirt_pairs = sorted(zip(boy_centers, shirt_centers), key=lambda x: abs(x[0] - x[1]))
    
    for boy_center, shirt_center in boy_shirt_pairs:
        boy_patch = next(p for p in boy_patches if (p.left + p.right) / 2 == boy_center)
        shirt_patch = next(p for p in shirt_patches if (p.left + p.right) / 2 == shirt_center)
        
        if shirt_patch.overlaps_with(*boy_patch.bbox()):
            return boy_patch
    
    return boy_patches[0]
